args.lesson: Worked: keyword-window reads of the saved one-line Shopify doc gave exact column names and the variant-row rule before coding. A stdlib transform plus an independent re-reading verifier passed 4/4, including 9000 synthetic barcodes (7500 images) in 0.3 s and a whole-product split. The earlier STOP was about the 20-row email channel, not delivery capability. Native CSV allows only ONE variant image per variant; per-color galleries depend on the theme or an app, so we only set color alt text. Failed: argv over 8192 chars and a lesson over 1000 chars were refused, and each sandbox needs makedirs. Next: no live Shopify import was tested and there is no buyer, channel or payment route. This is an unpublished sample; any release needs independent digest review.
